# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.3.2

*2026-11-03, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Store page and app links now point to this user guide. No change to how the app works.

## 1.3.1

*2026-10-24, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- Odoo 20.0 version.
- Fixed return links when the website address ends with a slash.

## 1.3.0

*2026-10-23, Odoo 17.0 - 19.0*

- Payments are verified with Bank Alfalah before they are posted.
- Refunds from Odoo.

## Earlier releases

*2026-08-07, Odoo 17.0 - 19.0*

- Published for Odoo 17.0, 18.0 and 19.0.
